# Material Symbols Rounded

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4/symbols/web

Apache-2.0; copyright Google. `icons.js` contains the unmodified SVG path data
for the icons used by this app: Rounded, weight 400, grade 0, optical size 24.
The viewBox is `0 -960 960 960`. Navigation also includes fill=1 variants.

To update, extract the `path` data from each symbol's
`materialsymbolsrounded/<name>_24px.svg` (and `<name>_fill1_24px.svg` for selected
navigation states) at a pinned upstream commit. Preserve LICENSE. No runtime
network or icon font is required.
